Recorded claim:
`commands/graph/rebase-resolution.mjs` snapshots every conflict file, uses Codex with `sandbox: "read-only"`, validates a complete JSON answer, generates one combined diff, and applies it as a batch. A valid response covers each conflict path exactly once and has text or `null` deletion content with no conflict markers. Continue and Cancel re-check the snapshot; manual edits after preview block automatic actions. Reject path/symlink escapes, binary/non-regular files, duplicates, malformed responses, failed AI calls, and overlapping runs without overwriting work. [Task 1]
